title: Fera feat. Mona Bode - Farewell To House (KingTouch's Dub Spin)

lines.l: Farewell to house, memories live on me, no more jacking my body, from midnight till dawn, I'm moving, I've spent years in this house, sweat, tears in this house, moved away fears in this house,
There's so many walls, echoing tunes off walls
This was my house, foundation built to last
But now, it's time has passed
But before I leave, I will conceive and rebirth again.
Gotta have house. My love won't die.
I am it and it is me.
I am it and it is me
